**Fabricated last meal ID**

`handleMealLogged` sets `lastMeal.meal.id` to `""` and fills in timestamps locally (`components/home/home-page-client.tsx:79-90`). This guarantees an invalid meal id for anything that uses `lastMeal.meal.id` (now or future), and it can also desync the “last meal feedback” card from the canonical server-created meal. It should store the actual meal returned by `POST /api/meals` (or at least its real id) instead of fabricating one.

🔴 **NLP parser produces amounts with units not accepted by API validation** The NLP meal parser normalizes amounts with units like `packet`, `sachet`, and `bowl` (e.g., "1/2 packet", "1 sachet", "2 bowl"), but the API validation regex only accepts `g|ml|oz|lb|kg|can|cans|cup|cups|tbsp|tsp|pouch|pouches`. This causes meal submissions to fail with validation errors.
Root Cause The NLP parser at `lib/nlp/meal-parser.ts:25-60` recognizes and normalizes amounts with units like `packet`, `sachet`, and `bowl`: ```typescript pattern: /\bhalf\s+(?:a\s+)?(can|cup|pouch|packet|sachet|bowl)\b/i, normalize: (m) => `1/2 ${m[1].toLowerCase()}`, ``` However, the API validation at `lib/validations.ts:149-151` uses a stricter regex that doesn't include these units: ```typescript const amountRegex = /^(\d+\/\d+|\d+(\.\d+)?)\s*(g|ml|oz|lb|kg|can|cans|cup|cups|tbsp|tsp|pouch|pouches)$/i; ``` **Impact:** When a user enters "half a packet of food" or "a sachet this morning", the NLP parser will show a valid-looking normalized amount ("1/2 packet" or "1 sachet"), but clicking "Log Meal" will result in a validation error from the API, confusing users who see their input accepted in the UI but rejected on submission.
Prompt for agents ``` Either remove support for packet, sachet, and bowl units from the NLP parser in lib/nlp/meal-parser.ts (lines 25-60), OR add these units to the API validation regex in lib/validations.ts at line 150. The regex should be updated to: /^(\d+\/\d+|\d+(\.\d+)?)\s*(g|ml|oz|lb|kg|can|cans|cup|cups|tbsp|tsp|pouch|pouches|packet|packets|sachet|sachets|bowl|bowls)$/i ```
